author: Imagenio
body:
Hi ^^
I am looking for a team... i am an experienced Overcast Network player, and i am the Captain of the Spanish  Overcast team "EnderFox". 
-I am a very strategic player and "cool pvp". 
-I play as midline, because im great with the bow, making staircases, watering etc.
-You can see my pvp skills here.
-I am Spanish, but i speak fluent english and can communicate well.
-Can use skype, TS3, Mumble...
-For me, KD is not very important but i think i have around 2 KD. I use to go for objectives in Nebula anyway.
-I am a good person and you'll have a great time with me (:

You can contact me at this post, by twitter, or by skype ("mrgeniusftw")

Thanks for considering me :)
